long_biography.plain_text:
The Stiftung Stahlwerk Georgsmarienhütte turned Jürgen Großmann's regional commitments into a permanent institution for education, culture, science, public health and charitable work. Created at his initiative for the steelworks' 150th anniversary, it funds projects intended to strengthen community life around the plant and beyond.

Großmann also spent a decade chairing the RAG-Stiftung's board of trustees as Germany ended hard-coal extraction and the foundation assumed responsibility for perpetual mining obligations. He later co-founded United Europe to promote cooperation across the continent. The association brings industrial and political figures together while running workshops that involve younger professionals in debates about Europe's future.
